_instructions: This is a template file. Copy this to create your own settings file:
Copy to 'settings-local.json' and remove MONGO_URL fields
Meteor will automatically use local MongoDB (no configuration needed)
Copy to 'settings-production.json' and add your MongoDB Atlas credentials
Or deploy with MONGO_URL environment variable
IMPORTANT: Never commit settings-local.json or settings-production.json to git!

private._comment_mongo: LOCAL: Omit MONGO_URL to use local MongoDB. PRODUCTION: Add MongoDB Atlas connection string
private._comment_telekurs: Shared secret for the Telekurs.xlsx price-push endpoint (POST /api/telekurs/quotes). The Excel VBA macro sends this in the X-API-Key header. Use any long random string.
private._comment_credentials_key: At-rest AES-256-GCM encryption key for stored third-party credentials (e.g. bank SFTP passwords). Any long random string (32+ hex chars recommended). WARNING: must be IDENTICAL in every environment that shares the same database (dev and prod share Atlas), and changing it orphans already-encrypted values.
private._comment_cbonds: CBonds API configuration for bond price queries
private._comment_email_bcc: Optional: Add email addresses to BCC on all product notification emails
private._comment_digest_test: When DAILY_DIGEST_TEST_EMAIL is set, digest will ONLY be sent to this email (for testing). Remove or set to empty string to send to all affected users (superadmins, admins, relationship managers).
private._comment_seeding: Control demo data seeding on startup
private._comment_retention: GDPR data-retention windows in days (dataRetention cron, 02:00 CET daily). Defaults shown.
private._comment_concurrency: Number of products to evaluate in parallel during nightly re-evaluation. Default: 3. Increase if CPU/DB can handle more.
private._comment_cron_disabled: Set true on dev machines sharing the production database: that instance schedules no cron jobs (syncs, digests, retention). Missing/false = crons run. Manual triggers always work.
